# Ethics statement

This work studies mechanistic interpretability of open-weight language
models on synthetic grammatical prompts. It does not involve human
subjects, personal data, or dual-use capabilities beyond standard
analysis of publicly released models and transcoder weights. Risks are
primarily those of over-interpreting mechanistic claims; we therefore
emphasize scoped negative results and release code and summaries for
scrutiny. Compute was limited to a single workstation-scale machine;
we report model and transcoder identifiers for reproducibility.
